name: Little Tree | 200mg Live Resin Gummies | Strawberry
description:
10 Gummies | 20MG Each | Live Resin

Our Strawberry Live Resin Gummies offer a ripe, uplifting edible experience. Each gummy contains 20MG of terpene-rich live resin for full-bodied effects and a flavor that’s as smooth as it is nostalgic.

With a soft texture and calming onset, this gummy is a favorite for mindful resets and mellow afternoons.

Whether you're stretching, sketching, or stargazing—this gummy grounds the moment.
